'''Roda Volcano''' is a location in the world of [[Ivalice]]. It is an active volcano, and many strange things have happened there.

==Appearances==
===''[[Final Fantasy XII: Revenant Wings]]''===

{{Main|Feol Warren}}
[[File:rodavolcano-ff12rw.PNG|right]]
Roda Volcano is home to the [[Viera#Final Fantasy XII: Revenant Wings|feol viera]], a sub-branch of the viera banished for being half-bloods. The party goes to Roda Volcano to rescue the feol viera from the [[Judge of Wings]], but are too late to stop her.

===''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]''===

{{Main|Roda Volcano (Tactics Advance)}}
Roda Volcano is a mountain location, and is the only place in [[Ivalice (Tactics Advance)|Ivalice]] besides [[Tubola Cave]] where lava flows. The [[Totema]] [[Ultima (Tactics Advance)|Ultima]] is battled here.

==Etymology ==
The word 'Roda' means 'wheel' in Portuguese, Malay and Indonesian.
